historyPolicy: Do not change historical or in-progress snapshots, actual sets, body measurements, plan versions or program contexts.
deploymentOrder: Back up database and capture catalog and program selection state
Deploy code supporting schema versions 1 and 2 and both old and new session shapes
Validate and preview the v2 pack against the live catalog
Import and activate the immutable v2 pack
Idempotently remap removed program selections and obsolete held-phase preferences
Verify existing history and an in-progress legacy session, then a new session with all three sections
rollbackPolicy: Keep the dual-format application version deployed if schema 2 sessions exist. Restore the active catalog pointer to the captured old pack without deleting new sessions or importing a forbidden lower pack version. Use a reviewed rollback command, not database replacement.
